items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: No. No. On that particular album with Woody, that wouldn’t have been him.

ctx.x: Absolutely yeah. In fact the trombone player said, “Jesus Christ, how long ago did Bill send you that chart?” I said, “Bill didn’t send me the chart, I’m looking at it right now.”
Would that have been Bill Holman?
No. No. On that particular album with Woody, that wouldn’t have been him.
